title: My solo indie game: Project M
author: marcosaypolo
selftext:
Hi, I'm a solo indie dev, and Project-M is my first official passion project game!

Despite the short time frame this took an insane amount of effort and sleepless nights, so I hope I'm creating something people would enjoy.

It's a turn-based monster-taming roguelike in Godot 4. You play as Pebs, a small pebble with the ability to transform into any mon

# What's in the game

* A turn-based dungeon crawler where every floor is new
* Terrain that reacts to you: burn the grass, ride the tide, cross cooling lava
* Every area has its own mons and its own events
* **Mossy Ruins:** first design almost done, 15 mons to bond with
* **Early access is coming soon**

Youtube link: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ngjTuDicjLk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ngjTuDicjLk)

If you'd like to follow along or support development: [https://www.patreon.com/cw/ProjectMGame](https://www.patreon.com/cw/ProjectMGame)
